name: Nuanchan Srisawat
bio:
Nuanchan's meticulous approach to quality control stems from her early fascination with the intricate mechanics of motorcycles in her father's repair shop. Growing up in Bangkok, she quickly learned the importance of precision and attention to detail. After earning a degree in engineering, she pursued her passion for motorsport, initially working with smaller racing teams before earning a coveted position at Team Penske. 

Nuanchan is known for her unflappable demeanor and ability to identify potential issues before they escalate. Her comprehensive understanding of vehicle dynamics, coupled with her commitment to continuous improvement, makes her an invaluable asset to the team. She believes in fostering a collaborative environment where every team member feels empowered to contribute to achieving the highest standards of performance and reliability.

physical.hairStyle: long, straight hair typically worn in a high ponytail
physical.description: Nuanchan is petite with a focused gaze.
